Meanwhile, Vance defended the administration’s military campaign during a Fox News town hall in Fort Worth, Texas, after a Republican voter questioned Trump’s promise to end costly foreign interventions.
Recalling his military service in Iraq, Vance acknowledged frustration with the U.S.’s prolonged involvement in the Middle East.

“We’ve been involved in Iran in some form for seven months. The U.S. has been dealing with Iran for 47 years, and I promise you that Donald Trump is not going to let Iran become a forever war,” he said.

Vance maintained that opposing prolonged military interventions does not mean rejecting military force altogether, adding that Trump would achieve America’s objectives before turning to other priorities.
